svg.aria-label: The Skribly project: three apps in development (Skribly Tracker on Node.js, Skribly Agent and agent-skills), the shared pieces (Skribly Core with the server kit, Skribly UI, Skribly Docs and the templates), the pieces being added (Skribly ID, Skribly API, Skribly Hub and the small sites), how a task flows from the Tracker through the Agent and agent-skills to a reviewed commit, the three public sites, and the five authors: Dawid Olko, Piotr Smoła, Michał Pilecki, Konrad Pluta and Mateusz Olko
